Example:
Let's have two matrices of 3x3 dimension and sum them. By summing them we mean that the elements of two matrices are added. The sum is also a matrix S of the same dimensions:

 [1 2 3] [9 8 7]
 S = [4 5 6] + [6 5 4] = 
 [7 8 9] [3 2 1]

 [10 10 10]
 = [10 10 10]
 [10 10 10]
